description: The plot titled “Finetuning for different \(r\), Gazeta” shows ROUGE-1 performance as a function of \(\log r\) for four finetuning configurations. The x-axis is labeled “\(\log r\)”, uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 9 with ticks at each integer. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 35 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 units. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: the red line (T5 + LoRA) starts near 23.3 at \(\log r=0\), increases gradually to about 24.4–24.5 around \(\log r=6\)–7, then slightly decreases to about 24.1 by \(\log r=9\); the blue line (MBart + LoRA) starts near 4.8 at \(\log r=0\), rises to about 8.0 at \(\log r=1\), drops to about 2.6 at \(\log r=2\), then increases sharply to about 19.0 at \(\log r=4\), reaches about 22.6 at \(\log r=5\), stays around 22.6–23.1 through \(\log r=7\), peaks near 24.0 at \(\log r=8\), and ends around 23.4 at \(\log r=9\); the green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) begins near 23.3 at \(\log r=0\), increases steadily to about 27.1 at \(\log r=4\), rises to about 29.0 at \(\log r=5\), and continues upward more gradually to about 30.2 by \(\log r=9\); the orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts near 4.9 at \(\log r=0\), increases to about 9.1 at \(\log r=1\), about 13.4 at \(\log r=2\), about 19.5 at \(\log r=3\), then jumps to about 32.0 at \(\log r=4\) and increases slightly thereafter, ending around 33.4 at \(\log r=9\).
